subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve moving the API-key-bearing `openai/codex-action` workflow steps from the currently pinned 1.8 revision to the proposed 1.11 revision?
rationale: This is a third-party executable dependency change in secret-bearing CI workflows; source and supply-chain acceptance requires maintainer intent rather than an automated mechanical repair.

options.title: Audit and approve the Codex Action revision
options.body: Review the upstream revision and accept the pin only after a redacted successful run confirms the credentialed workflow behavior.

options.title: Split out the Codex Action update
options.body: Land independently validated non-Codex Action bumps and defer the secret-bearing Codex Action revision for a dedicated security review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Close or replace this bulk dependency PR if the exact Codex Action revision cannot be approved promptly.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the Codex Action revision
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revision and accept the pin only after a redacted successful run confirms the credentialed workflow behavior.
